title: Base change for the pushforward along an affine morphism, and quasi-coherence of that pushforward
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that for an affine morphism the pushforward of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent and agrees with the derived pushforward, and that it commutes with base change (statement lines 1901-1911). The proof invokes the reduction to representable morphisms of algebraic spaces, which puts the question in the scheme case covered by the corresponding statement in Cohomology of Schemes. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
